description.content: This API lists the fields that can be used in criteria of a specified module in layout rules. Available pre-defined values may contain ${EMPTY}, ${NOTEMPTY}, ${OPEN}, ${CLOSED}, ${CURRENTTIME}. Available types are Text, Date, DateTime, Text, Boolean and Arithmetic.

query.description: (Required) Category for getting the field criteria for primary or secondary fields

response.name: getCriteriaResponse template definitions
